steps.label: Set Stacking preset (5 boxes stacked on a floor)
Precondition: bottom box (body 1) starts at y=0.5
Precondition: top box (body 5) starts at y=4.5
Precondition: no contacts before the stack settles
Let the stack settle under gravity (~5s)
Change: settling under gravity produced contacts between the resting boxes
Invariant: bottom box stays near the floor, doesn't fly away
Invariant: bottom box velocity bounded (not exploding)
Invariant: top box stays above the floor, doesn't fly away
Invariant: top box velocity bounded (not exploding)
